--headed.rationale: pire-browser controls an already-headed Firefox WebExtension session.

--headless.rationale: The Firefox WebExtension backend cannot make an already-running profile headless per command.

--color-scheme.rationale: Per-command color scheme cannot be applied reliably to an already-running Firefox profile.

--max-output.rationale: Output limit policy belongs to Epic 7.

--content-boundaries.rationale: Content boundary policy belongs to Epic 7.

--allowed-domains.rationale: Domain allowlist policy belongs to Epic 7.

--confirm-actions.rationale: Action confirmation policy belongs to Epic 7.

--config.rationale: Config loading is not part of the Epic 2 core loop.

--executable-path.rationale: Browser binary selection belongs to lifecycle/profile work, not per-command runtime.

--engine.rationale: Engine selection belongs to Epic 8 backends.

--provider.rationale: Provider selection belongs to Epic 8 backends.

-p.rationale: Provider shorthand belongs to Epic 8 backends.

--model.rationale: Model selection is not meaningful for the Firefox WebExtension backend.

--allow-file-access.rationale: File access policy belongs to Epic 7.

--auto-connect.rationale: CDP auto-connect belongs to Epic 8 backend work.

--confirm-interactive.rationale: Interactive confirmation policy belongs to Epic 7.

-q.rationale: Quiet logging compatibility is deferred until CLI output policy is reviewed.

-v.rationale: Verbose logging compatibility is covered by Epic 2 lite observability and later output policy.
